p1: You are standing about {stops.s1.above_outlet_words} metres above the point where this water meets the *Munster Blackwater*, and {stops.s1.to_outlet_words} metres from it. Everything that falls on about {stops.s1.upstream_ha} hectares upstream of here passes this spot.
p2: Look at the bed. The stones are angular and the gravel bars are loose. Loose sediment on a stream bed is one of the things that decides whether it can hold fish, because eggs laid in gravel need clean water moving through them.
